notes.title: Ember and Blade Patch Notes - 2025.07.29
notes.notes:
[p]We have released a minor update to address a few important issues following our previous patch. [/p][p]As always, thank you for your feedback and support!
[/p][p][b]Hotfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing the L3 button on Steam Deck/Linux triggered an unexpected error window.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where Michael’s “Righteous Bladefall” could leave the player in an unusable state if cast on a mid-boss that had already been marked as dead.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected an issue where skill numbers were not displayed properly on certain operating systems.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We recommend updating to the latest build to ensure the best possible experience.[/p][p]If you encounter any further issues, please let us know through the Community Hub or via Discord.[/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and look forward to bringing you more exciting updates for Ember and Blade![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]— Ember and Blade Team[/p]

notes.title: Ember and Blade Patch Notes - 2025.07.24
notes.notes: [p]In this update, we have improved game performance, made important balance adjustments, fixed several bugs, and enhanced the user interface based on player feedback. Thanks for your continued support—please stay tuned for upcoming improvements![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Important Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced lag during initial effect triggers to improve overall performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on certain PCs where camera shake and attack ranges were abnormally displayed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balance Patch[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced Blessing level 5 probability: 35% → 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Blessing 3-star (level 6) probability: 5% → 15%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Fenrix base HP: 200 → 240[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Fenrix base movement speed: 5.3 m/s → 5.8 m/s[/p][/*][*][p]Fenrix ranged weapon movement speed now matches regular speed (4.2 m/s → 5.8 m/s)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Fenrix ranged weapon projectile damage and firing interval[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased Fenrix special attack damage[/p][/*][*][p]Increased dash regeneration: 0.2 dash/sec → 0.25 dash/sec[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Meteor Flower and Flame durations[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy stats up to 6 minutes: HP decreased by 8%, ATK decreased by 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Elite Banshee: removed brief invincibility after attacks, prevented knockback of Fenrix when attacked[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bark calls (e.g., ShrineSense, Use Artifact, Use Weakness Attack) triggered too frequently.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Baphomet’s HP remained high even after Arbor Reach purifications.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]UI Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Slightly moved Bark UI downward for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Blessing backgrounds now change based on Star level to improve user experience clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]HP bars no longer appear for monsters with very low maximum health.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing Ember and Blade! [/p][p]Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve the game. We look forward to bringing you more exciting updates soon.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]— Ember and Blade Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ⚡Demo Version Hotfix (Patch Completed)
notes.notes: [p]We’ve completed a new hotfix addressing several issues previously identified in the demo version.[/p][p]The latest patch is now live, so whether you’re launching the game for the first time or reinstalling, you’ll automatically have the newest version—delivering enhanced stability and a smoother experience.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]\[What’s Fixed in This Patch][/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Lag on First-Time VFX[/b] [/p][p]The issue where the game would temporarily freeze the first time certain visual effects appeared has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Volume Settings Not Working[/b][/p][p]Problems preventing some sound effects and background music from responding to in-game volume adjustments have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Black Screen on Game Start[/b][/p][p]We have addressed the problem where, on some PCs, the game could get stuck on a black screen right after launching.[/p][/*][/olist][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your patience while we worked on these improvements.[/p][p]Our team remains dedicated to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]– Ember and Blade Team[/p]

notes.title: ⚡ Hotfix Announcement: Demo Version Update (Planned)
notes.notes:
[p]We are currently working on a hotfix to address several issues discovered during the demo.[/p][p]Among them, the VFX lag and sound volume adjustment problems will be prioritized and resolved first in an upcoming patch.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]\[[b]Scheduled Fixes in the Incoming Hotfix][/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]VFX Lag on Initial Load[/b]
Some visual effects may cause the game to temporarily freeze the first time they appear.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Volume Adjustment Not Working[/b] Certain sound effects and background music do not respond correctly to volume changes.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]\[Known Issues][/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Level-Up Not Triggering After First Expedition[/b] After starting a New Game or clearing Baphomet, there are rare cases where leveling up may not be possible if the level-up and certain event cutscenes overlap:[/p][p]– When purifying the Small Sanctuary Tree[/p][p]– Within 0.5 seconds of the Seraphiel statue cutscene[/p][/*][*][p][b]Black Screen on Game Start[/b] [/p][p]On some systems, the game may remain on a black screen at launch. We suspect this may be related to extended loading times and are currently investigating the cause.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]The upcoming hotfix is currently in its final stages of preparation and will be deployed soon to improve overall stability and gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience and continued support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p]– Ember and Blade Team[/p]
